High resolution physio-chemical data collected from an automatic buoy at Esthwaite Water, England (2025)

Esthwaite_Buoy_HiRes.Rd

High resolution physio-chemical data collected from an automatic buoy at Esthwaite Water, England (2025)

Usage

Esthwaite_Buoy_HiRes

Format

A data frame with one row per timestamp and 23 variables:

TIMESTAMP

Date and time of observation (POSIXct)

RECORD

Logger record number

AirTemp

Air temperature (deg C)

RH

Relative humidity (%)

Temp_RH

Temperature at the RH sensor (deg C)

WindSpd

Wind speed (m/s)

WindDir

Wind direction (degrees)

SPFD

Spectral photon flux density / PAR (units as logged)

CMP6

CMP6 pyranometer shortwave radiation (W/m2)

PonselTemp

Ponsel probe water temperature (deg C)

PonselCond

Ponsel probe conductivity (units as logged)

Temp1m

Water temperature at roughly 1 m depth (deg C)

Temp2m

Water temperature at roughly 2 m depth (deg C)

Temp3m

Water temperature at roughly 3 m depth (deg C)

Temp4m

Water temperature at roughly 4 m depth (deg C)

Temp5m

Water temperature at roughly 5 m depth (deg C)

Temp6m

Water temperature at roughly 6 m depth (deg C)

Temp7m

Water temperature at roughly 7 m depth (deg C)

Temp8m

Water temperature at roughly 8 m depth (deg C)

Temp9m

Water temperature at roughly 9 m depth (deg C)

Temp10m

Water temperature at roughly 10 m depth (deg C)

Temp11m

Water temperature at roughly 11 m depth (deg C)

Temp12m

Water temperature at roughly 12 m depth (deg C)

See also

[Esthwaite_Buoy_SUNA_Data()], [Esthwaite_Buoy_OLD]
